description: This file defines the OrganizationService class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, providing methods to interact with organization data via an OrganizationDao, including retrieving and saving general organization information.

classes.name: OrganizationService
classes.description: A service class that manages organization data operations, including retrieving and saving general information.

methods.name: getOrganizationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the OrganizationDao object used for database operations.

methods.name: setOrganizationDao
methods.description: Sets the OrganizationDao instance, useful for dependency injection or mocking.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves general information of the organization.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves or updates the organization's general information and may throw a TransactionException.
